subject: TEST RESULT: display-state renderability model confirms readiness over-admission
body: WORK_UNIT=exhaustive display-state readiness model. NEW_INFORMATION=Current coordinator predicate (state != OFF && state != UNKNOWN) admits 25/49 documented inner/cover Display-state pairs when route/default/id facts are otherwise valid. It admits cover=ON_SUSPEND and cover=DOZE_SUSPEND with inner=ON, allowing a source-faithful simplified coordinator to advance COVER_PREWARMING -> COVER_READY_HIDDEN even though Android documents both suspended states as CPU-not-updating. A Fold7-only fail-closed readiness predicate state==STATE_ON admits only ON/ON and advances once the cover reaches ON. EVIDENCE_CLASS=source+platform+deterministic-model. TEST_OR_COMMAND=python -m unittest -v test_display_renderability_model.py. RESULT=14/14 PASS; exhaustive model PASS. DESIGN_IMPLICATION=split topology presence from continuity renderability; do not globally tighten controller isActive(). Gen3 Alpha1 patch search contains no STATE_DOZE/STATE_ON_SUSPEND/isActive renderability change, so this gap survives the current candidate package. REQUIRES_PRIMARY_VERIFICATION=YES. RECOMMENDED_PRIMARY_ACTION=revalidate on post-Gen3 main, preserve controller topology semantics, feed strict renderability booleans only into Fold7CoverReadiness, add exact Display.state telemetry, then device-measure any wait for STATE_ON.
